checks.reason: Testbench allowed an unmodeled clock edge after reset release.

limitations: Development verification only; official evaluation has not run.
No synthesis or board verification performed.
Initial state before reset is unspecified and is not asserted by the testbench.

justified_tb_changes.change: Release reset just after the checked rising edge instead of after the following falling edge.
justified_tb_changes.justification: The original reset task returned after a falling edge; step then waited for another falling edge, allowing a rising edge with stale input without updating the oracle. Corrected scheduling ensures every non-reset rising edge is modeled; expected values and coverage requirements are unchanged.

interface_cycle_contract: TopModule(clk, areset, in, out); one-bit ports; positive-edge state updates; positive-edge active-high asynchronous reset to A; Moore output high only in D.
static_review: All four table rows implemented with explicit if/else; two-bit enum state; nonblocking sequential assignments; complete combinational next-state logic; no extra output latency.
